notes: Wix ran the longest setup interview in the set (business type, tone, audience, apps, domain), generated a complete site in the editor where the preview looked right, and published. What went live is empty: the wixsite address shows only the Wix badge, and the root URL returns "SEITE NICHT GEFUNDEN". The editor preview and the live site disagree, which is the worst failure mode for a beginner: it looks finished until someone opens the link.
